title: Offline Ambient-Controlled Latent Diffusion: Architecture, Telemetry, and On-Device Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most mobile image-generation applications are thin clients over cloud services, leaving outputs hard to audit. We present an Android latent-diffusion application that runs entirely on-device and is driven by the ambient-light sensor rather than a text prompt, keeping generation, telemetry, and storage local. The contribution is not a new diffusion method but the surrounding measurement workflow: each output is bound to the sensor reading, runtime path, and seed that produced it, giving a per-artifact audit trail for offline analysis. On a single Samsung foldable, one fixed capture of 373 artifacts shows the controller's log-lux input positively associated with output luminance (Pearson $r=0.532$, 95\% CI $[0.455, 0.601]$), confirming the ambient dependency survives denoising and VAE decoding, while the latent UNet/VAE pipeline runs at 552--1334\,ms mean latency across three quality tiers under the Android Neural Networks API (NNAPI).

translated_title: 离线环境控制潜在扩散：架构、遥测与设备端评估
translated_abstract: 大多数移动图像生成应用是云服务的瘦客户端，导致输出难以审计。我们提出了一款完全在设备端运行的Android潜在扩散应用，它由环境光传感器而非文本提示驱动，将生成、遥测和存储全部保留在本地。本研究的贡献并非新的扩散方法，而是围绕测量工作流程：每个输出都与产生它的传感器读数、运行时路径和种子绑定，为离线分析提供了每个工件的审计轨迹。在一台三星折叠设备上，一次固定的373个工件的采集显示，控制器的对数光照输入与输出亮度正相关（Pearson r=0.532，95%置信区间[0.455, 0.601]），证实了环境依赖性在去噪和VAE解码后仍然存在，而潜在UNet/VAE管道在Android神经网络API（NNAPI）下，三个质量档次的平均延迟为552-1334毫秒。
tldr: 本文介绍了一款完全在设备端运行的Android潜在扩散应用，通过环境光传感器控制图像生成，并为每个输出绑定传感器读数、运行时路径和种子，形成可审计的离线追踪记录，实验证实环境光照与输出亮度显著相关，且性能在NNAPI下可接受。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fully on-device Android latent-diffusion app driven by ambient-light sensor, binding each output to sensor readings, runtime paths, and seeds for auditable offline tracking, showing significant correlation between ambient light and output luminance with acceptable NNAPI performance.
